business_problem: Saved ROLLER's internal payments team days of manual data aggregation work per week, reducing the task to minutes Eliminated engineering bottlenecks by transitioning from manual SQL scripting to a self-service data model
solution_summary: With a robust data foundation established, ROLLER is now leading the attractions industry into a future defined by generative AI and seamless data accessibility. The team recently launched 'ROLLER iQ,' an innovative conversational AI chatbot built on Google Cloud, using Vertex AI that brings data to life through natural language, with Gemini 3 Flash + Gemini 3.1 Pro for deeper questions and insights. This project was a major focus for the data engineering and ML teams, who leveraged their deep knowledge of ROLLER's data to build a tool that outpaced traditional product development timelines. By integrating directly with Looker APIs, ROLLER iQ ensures that every answer provided in a chat is perfectly consistent with the official dashboards. This breakthrough allows venue managers to ask complex questions and receive immediate, trusted answers, making data interaction more intuitive than ever before.
